widgets.text: Left/right walk, A jump. One hit kills.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: The air supply runs down: finish each cavern before it runs out.
widgets.label: Air

widgets.text: Jumps are fixed arcs: commit before you jump.
widgets.label: Jumps

widgets.text: Guardians move on fixed paths: time your crossing. Crumbling floors vanish after standing on them.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: 20 caverns; collect all flashing keys then reach the portal.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Flashing keys (items) must all be collected to open the portal.
